rationale: Overcomes the -$9,500 cash deficit by breaking the 24-plot ceiling to expand contiguous land to 30-32 plots through Day 17, while strictly capping the workforce at 10 hands (~3.0-3.2 plots/hand) to perfectly saturate the 10-order engine cap without dropping market orders or worker actions. It replaces the premature Day 3 flash switch with a robust 2-cycle Carrot liquidity engine (Days 1-4) yielding $1,500+ working capital, reclaims lucrative 2.0x-3.5x town shop margins by dedicating 4-6 flexible contract plots while buffering 8-12 shed items against premature open-market dumping, implements a Day 23-27 rapid Carrot cash-out on open acreage, and decouples cluster harvesting (>= 80% backpack capacity) from dedicated cluster watering passes to eliminate pathfinding and well detours.
